rows.name: AIPERIA
rows.description: AIPERIA, a German-based SaaS solution, helps suppliers and retailers in sustainable demand planning for fresh food by enabling end-to-end planning from production to supermarket shelves to ensure only what is sold is produced.

rows.name: Aiven
rows.description: Aiven is a technology-driven company that enables businesses to manage an open-source data infrastructure in the cloud. Headquartered in Helsinki with offices in Berlin, Sydney, Toronto, and Boston, Aiven provides managed open-source data technologies, like PostgreSQL, Kafka, and M3, on all major clouds. It enables its customers to drive business results from open-source that trigger true transformations far beyond their own backyards.

rows.name: Aleph Alpha
rows.description: Aleph Alpha transforms human-machine interactions. The company researches, develops, and operationalizes AI-based technology for the public and private sectors. Its generative AI solutions enable enterprises and governmental organizations to build intelligent products.

rows.name: Alesi Surgical
rows.description:
Alesi Surgical was founded in 2009 to develop and commercialise products that improve the safety, efficacy, and outcomes of surgical procedures. The company is a spin-out from the Welsh Institute for Minimal Access Therapy (WIMAT), a leading surgical training centre in the UK. 

Alesi Surgical has a unique level of access to experienced surgeons, surgical trainers, and trainees, which allows it to identify issues in procedures and design devices to address these issues.

rows.name: Arago Inc.
rows.description: Arago develops a computing system that uses photonic technology to accelerate core operations in Artificial Intelligence and scientific computing. The company focuses on enhancing matrix multiplication performance, a key computational component in modern AI models, by using light-based processes rather than traditional electronic circuits. Its system integrates a PyTorch-based software stack with a multi-physics processor that handles tasks with cubic complexity, while a digital processor manages remaining operations with quadratic complexity. rows.name: Argá Medtech SA
rows.description: Argá Medtech is a medical device company that specializes in the manufacturing of innovative cardiac ablation systems for the treatment of cardiac arrhythmias.

rows.name: Aris Machina
rows.description: Aris Machina is an agentic operating system and AI application platform for modern manufacturing, engineering, and industrial R&D. It connects machines, people, and data across research, industrialization, and operations.

rows.name: Avrea
rows.description: Avrea is a CI/CD platform built for the new era of development. Once code is created by a developer or an AI agent, Avrea ensures it can be tested, validated, and shipped faster, more often, and with higher quality. The platform includes lightning-fast CI/CD runners, deep pipeline observability, and AI-powered features that improve build reliability and test quality. Migration is a one-line change in your workflow, and Avrea is ISO 27001 certified.

rows.name: B2X
rows.description:
B2X is the provider of customer care solutions for electronic devices to manufacturers, insurance providers, mobile network operators, and retailers globally.

B2X has created the first shared services platform for unparalleled customer care solutions. Their Smart Service Platform consists of a global organization of highly experienced staff, a trusted and reliable operational fulfillment partner network, and best practice service delivery processes. An end-to-end technology platform ensures consistency and quality across your service operations.

rows.description: Bayshore turns laws and policies into executable, auditable logic that governs ai agents—delivering real-time, explainable, regulator-ready compliance across your enterprise. Leading public companies work with us to streamline their compliance and legal processes. # imprint

rows.description: Brandback is a resale infrastructure company that enables online retailers to seamlessly integrate resale options directly into their e-commerce platforms—including baskets, product listings, and checkouts. This embedded approach allows retailers to offer customers a frictionless resale experience, transforming every purchase into a tradable asset and unlocking new revenue streams for brands.

rows.name: Briefcase
rows.description: Briefcase is an AI-powered tool for bookkeeping and month-end automation designed specifically for Professional Services practices.

rows.name: CARTO
rows.description: Carto is a platform that turns spatial data into an efficient delivery route, better behavioral marketing, and strategic store placements. From smartphones to connected cars, location data is changing the way we live and the way business happens. CARTO is the platform that turns spatial data into more efficient delivery routes, better behavioral marketing, strategic store placements, and much more. rows.description:
The world's most advanced copyright protection service for content creators!

With Ceartas DMCA, you can easily monitor your content and manage your rights-lines. Our proprietary technology keeps you safe from copyright infringement, protecting you and the value of your creations with lightning-quick takedowns at a price to suit every need.

rows.name: Celus
rows.description: Celus creates an online software solution to empower development teams to easily build embedded systems, without deep knowledge about electronics. Our software automatically generates schematics, PCB floor planning, BOM, and embedded source code through automation and artificial intelligence.

rows.name: Certivity
rows.description: Certivity is a software company that provides AI-powered compliance management solutions for organizations operating in regulated industries. Its platform helps teams manage regulatory requirements, monitor changes, map obligations to internal policies and controls, and maintain compliance documentation. The company focuses on automating compliance workflows and supporting regulatory intelligence across business operations.

rows.name: CONXAI
rows.description: CONXAI develops a no-code artificial intelligence platform designed to automate knowledge-intensive workflows in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industries. The company enables organizations to transform fragmented project data, documents, and tacit human expertise into structured, actionable insights that support decision-making and operational efficiency. rows.name: Draftwise
rows.description: DraftWise provides an AI-powered contract and negotiation platform that assists law firms in procuring quality contracts. The company's platform provides lawyers with data-driven intelligence that improves the contract workflow, from first draft to client win.

rows.name: Earlybird Venture Capital
rows.description: Founded in 1997, Earlybird invests in all development and growth phases of technology companies. Among the most experienced venture investors in Europe, Earlybird offers its portfolio companies not only financial resources but also strategic support plus access to an international network and capital markets. With EUR 2 billion under management, eight IPOs, and 30 trade sales, Earlybird is one of the most established and active venture capital firms in Europe.

rows.name: edyoucated
rows.description: EdYoucated is an all-in-one platform for skills and learning. It's completely modular and works in tandem with their existing systems. They can strategically build skills, managers can make their employees happy, and learners can achieve their goals more efficiently.

rows.name: eleQtron
rows.description: EleQtron is a technology company focused on the development and operation of quantum computers using ion-based qubits controlled through microwave-driven methods. Its systems are built on a proprietary approach known as MAGIC (Magnetic Gradient Induced Coupling), which enables precise and scalable control of quantum states for computational tasks. The company designs quantum hardware intended to solve complex problems that are difficult or impractical for conventional supercomputers, supporting applications in areas such as materials research, logistics, pharmaceuticals, and financial analysis

rows.name: EthonAI
rows.description: EthonAI develops an AI-powered platform that combines quality inspection and root cause analysis in manufacturing. The company's no-code applications can be easily used by factory operators and engineers without writing a single line of code.

rows.name: Everoad by sennder
rows.description:
Based out of Berlin, sennder was founded in 2015 by David Nothacker, Nicolaus Schefenacker, and Julius Koehler. In 2020, Everoad, the French leader in digital freight forwarding based in Paris and founded by Maxime Legardez, merged with sennder to become Europe's leading digital freight forwarder. By merging with sennder, Everoad becomes "Everoad by sennder."

rows.name: finmid
rows.description: Finmid is the embedded lending infrastructure powering platform growth. Finmid enables platforms to launch tailored financing products for their business customers at scale across 30 European markets via single integration. Across industries and business models, Finmid drives revenue, improves retention, and fuels core business growth. Finmid is trusted by Europe’s most ambitious platforms, including Wolt, Delivery Hero, Bolt, Just Eat Takeaway, Guesty, and FREENOW. Learn more at finmid.com.

rows.name: Flanks
rows.description: Flanks is a wealth management technology company that provides a data platform for financial advisors, wealth managers, banks, family offices, and other financial institutions. Its platform aggregates data from banks, brokers, custodians, and alternative asset providers, then standardizes, reconciles, and enriches information across financial and non-financial assets. Flanks also provides portfolio dashboards, wealth reports, financial simulations, investor portals, and AI-based tools for portfolio analysis and advisory workflows.

rows.name: Getsafe
rows.description: Getsafe is a digital insurance company that creates a better insurance experience for everyone. Powered by its unique technological platform, Getsafe makes insurance simple, fair, and accessible. As Getsafe replaces complexity and manual paperwork with smart bots and automation, customers can file claims or change their coverage in real time with just a few clicks.

rows.name: Greenlyte Carbon Technologies
rows.description: GCT operates a low energy DAC approach to capture CO2 while generating hydrogen as a byproduct. The process consists of three main process steps: absorption in a liquid, precipitation, and desorption through alkaline electrolysis. The technology is based on 15 years of research, with relevant patent applications filed and working prototypes. The company was founded as a university spin-out by two serial entrepreneurs and an experienced DAC researcher.

rows.name: Hilo
rows.description: Hilo is a healthcare company that provides a blood pressure intelligence platform to measure blood pressure. The company develops cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitoring technology, offering a wrist-worn device and mobile application that utilize optical sensors and machine learning algorithms to measure blood pressure without the need for traditional cuffs. Hilo's technology captures readings approximately every 90 minutes, including during sleep, providing users and healthcare professionals with comprehensive blood pressure data.

rows.name: Hive
rows.description:
Hive stores and ships products for small and medium-sized online merchants the next day. The company's multichannel integrations, D2C and B2B orders, custom packaging, and smooth return handling will help to optimize the operations. It integrates with over fifteen delivery carriers, and inventory is automatically distributed between five fulfillment centers to save money and time.

Hive was founded in 2020 and is based in Berlin, Germany.

rows.name: HiveMQ
rows.description: HiveMQ empowers businesses to transform with the most trusted MQTT platform. Designed to connect, communicate, and control IoT data under real-world stress, the HiveMQ MQTT Platform is the proven enterprise standard and powers use cases in automotive, energy, logistics, smart manufacturing, transportation, and more. Leading brands like Audi, BMW, Honeywell, Liberty Global, Mercedes-Benz, Siemens, and ZF choose HiveMQ to build smarter IoT projects, modernize factories, and create better customer experiences.

rows.name: Inkitt
rows.description: Inkitt is building the Disney of the 21st Century, standing at the forefront of technology and entertainment. rows.description: This company launches small and medium-sized satellites and satellite constellations into Earth’s orbit to ensure flexible and cost-efficient access to space for governments, institutions, and companies.

Keel is a London-based startup offering modern businesses a much-needed third choice between off-the-shelf and no-code tools. Keel has developed a powerful programmable operations platform which offers all the benefits of bespoke tooling without the need to build from scratch.

Keel was founded in 2022 by Benoit Machefer, Tom Frew, and Jon Bretman, who directly experienced the frustration of being underserved by off-the-shelf software when scaling the fastest growing online pharmacy in Europe to over $130M revenue. rows.description: Koppla is the user-friendly construction schedule shared by all contractors during construction execution. Built on data, construction projects can be easily planned, steered, and optimized in real time.

rows.name: Korial
rows.description:
Korial is the enterprise artificial intelligence platform that makes fully autonomous industrial operations possible – across any asset, any device, any environment, and any scale.

By unifying robots, drones, sensors, and data into one AI operating layer, it continuously turns raw telemetry into verified insight and orchestrated action that improves safety, reliability and efficiency.

rows.name: M0
rows.description: Developer of an infrastructure platform designed for powering builders of safe, programmable, interoperable stablecoins. The company's platform provides a decentralized, on-chain protocol, as well as a corresponding set of off-chain standards and APIs, that allows holders of high-quality eligible collateral to participate in the issuance of a fungible crypto dollar and developers to build safe programmable and interoperable digital dollars, enabling institutional participants to mint a fungible crypto dollar.

rows.name: Marvel Fusion
rows.description:
Marvel Fusion is a developer of fusion energy technology used to offer environment-friendly and safe energy. Its reactor is based on the short pulse, high energy, and electrically efficient laser that is suited for commercializing baseload fusion electrical power, helping consumers to access clean, safe, and reliable energy sources.

The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Munich, Bayern.

It uses mostly public data, including website information, certifications, sustainability information, company KPIs, customer relationships, and more. Matchory software helps strategic buyers and tech scouts in their daily sourcing business to make more efficient and reliable decisions. Its platform automates candidate sourcing, screening, matching, and interview workflows using AI agents. By streamlining recruitment processes, it helps organizations reduce manual effort, accelerate hiring, and improve talent acquisition efficiency.

rows.name: N26
rows.description:
N26 offers mobile banking solutions to customers in the European Union through its subsidiary. It provides international money transfer, investment, overdraft, and cash withdrawal and deposits at stores.

N26 provides mobile banking services for customers. Its mobile banking services offer online banking that includes making and handling of current accounts, fixed accounts, and other banking services, letting customers manage and control their banking details via a smartphone application easily.

NFON's outsourced telephone systems, called IP Centrex, are offered as a complete package from a single source. Operated by a fully redundant, high-performance computer centre and with more than 100 functions, the solution is designed to enable companies of all sizes to save up to 50% of the costs for a conventional phone system.

rows.description: Obligate allows companies to issue on-chain bonds and commercial paper to receive funding from investors in a regulated DeFi environment. The company utilizes smart contracts and tokenization in place of intermediaries such as paying and issuer agents to be able to reduce the costs associated with a bond issuance by 80% and reduce the time needed for an issuance from weeks to hours. Obligat was founded in 2019 and is located in Zurich, Switzerland.

rows.description: OneFootball is an app and platform that provides comprehensive coverage of over 100 international soccer leagues and competitions. It includes live scores, news, and video highlights. The app caters to soccer enthusiasts with features like fixtures, stats, and a calendar of all competitions worldwide, making it a must-have for fans. OneFootball partners with various organizations, including Major League Soccer, to deliver content globally, ensuring fans stay updated on their favorite leagues.

Formed from the combination of Gourmey and Vital Meat, the company builds on deep expertise in cell cultivation, bioprocessing, and food science. Its solutions provide high-resolution imaging of current flow, enabling engineers to identify shorts, opens, leakage paths, and other hidden defects while supporting yield improvement and process optimization. They digitalize the truckload-shipping ecosystem by providing mobile apps to drivers, fleet management tools to carrier managers, and logistics management solutions to shippers. rows.name: ShapeShift
rows.description: ShapeShift is a web and API platform formed in July of 2014 to provide instant Bitcoin and altcoin conversion with the maximum level of consumer protection and efficiency. In summer of 2019, the new ShapeShift platform launched to enable B2C users to self-custody their crypto assets, and buy, sell, trade, track, send, and receive all without trusting a 3rd party. ShapeShift also built and operates the real-time crypto market data service CoinCap.io, and acquired hardware wallet company KeepKey in mid-2017. The company is run by industry veteran Erik Voorhees.

It is providing a cloud-based simulation tool, educational hub, and collaborative community of innovators.

rows.name: Smava
rows.description: Smava, one of the credit comparison portals in Germany, continued the strong growth path of previous years in 2019: The brokered loan volume grew by 35% from around EUR 2 billion in 2018 to around EUR 2.7 billion. Likewise, Smava grew again significantly in the first quarter of 2020: Smava was able to increase the loan volume brokered by 45% compared to the same quarter of the previous year to approx. EUR 900 million. In total, Smava has already brokered more than EUR 8 billion in loans.

Terralayr develops and manages its own battery storage assets, currently operating one asset, with several under construction and a development pipeline exceeding 5GW in Germany.

rows.name: TopK
rows.description:
TopK features native support for both vector search and keyword search in a single, unified system. With its powerful query expression language, TopK enables you to build reliable search applications (semantic search, RAG, multi-modal, you name it) without juggling multiple databases or services. 

Our unified retrieval engine will evolve to support document transformation, query understanding (parse metadata filters from user query), and adaptive ranking (provide more relevant results by sending “relevance feedback” back to TopK) under one roof.

rows.description: Ubitricity has developed a highly efficient solution to make charging and billing of green electricity affordable everywhere. To this end, Ubitricity has developed an intelligent charging cable which entails all metering and billing technology: the SmartCable. Our Saas Product, Wallet Studio, is a digital wallet engagement and automation suite that enables companies to transform digital wallet cards into dynamic, interactive, meaningful and invaluable communication hubs. rows.name: Workist

Workist is a business process automation based on RPA robots called AI Workers that learn through human-AI teamwork. Its B2B transactions are translated, allowing for seamless integration and automated data exchange between business customers, distributors, and suppliers. Using AI, they hope to free up people's time to do more creative and meaningful work. Workist automates the processing of incoming purchase orders so that no one has to manually type in documents again.

Workist was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Berlin, Germany.
